name: bite_down_damage_is_the_creatures_current_power
notes: Printed: 'Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.' Seat 0's Counter Bear is printed 2/2 and carries two +1/+1 counters, so its power is 4: it deals 4 damage to seat 1's 0/4 Wall, which dies (a 2-damage bite would leave it alive). The Bear is unharmed. A second, untouched Plain Bear of seat 1 is not hurt.
